translation_notes: context shim: nanopub_shim.py puts the Nanopublication/nanopub-py@05022dc4bc checkout on sys.path; conftest_shim.py replaces tests/conftest.py, whose real version downloads the nanopub test suite from GitHub at import time via nanopub-testsuite-connector (not installed, not reproducible)

the rsa-key1 key pair (id_rsa, id_rsa.pub, 1 kB total) was copied verbatim from nanopub-testsuite@main:transform/signed/rsa-key1/key/ (MIT, (c) 2022 Tobias Kuhn) so the region runs offline; checked: it reproduces exactly the expected trusty artifact code RAcU1AR3dS0ricV5G_ENcpUCk40XuCvFW3tVFqxNEQzT4
the add becomes assertion += g{ {BNode("test")} hycl:claims "This is a test of nanopub-python" }

KEY FINDING: the obvious idiomatic form _:test is WRONG here. An ldpy _:label is a blank node fresh at each evaluation, whose rdflib label is a random Nxxxx id, whereas BNode("test") carries the label test - and the label is observable: nanopub folds it into the trusty artifact code, so _:test produced a different (and therefore failing) source_uri. The blank node label had to stay a Python BNode(...) interpolation.
the region has no return value; its own asserts (valid signature + expected trusty code, which hashes every triple) are the check and they run on both sides
